title: Customer deposits a check with Truist Mobile (standard or Immediate Availability)
customer_goal: Deposit a paper check without visiting a branch

governance.access_policy: Public-source competitive intelligence; legal review before external sharing

moments.title: Tap Deposit / check-deposit widget on home screen
moments.customer_action: Tap Deposit / check-deposit widget on home screen
moments.action: Tap Deposit / check-deposit widget on home screen

moments.title: From the main menu tap Deposits; endorse the check (sign, then write…
moments.customer_action: From the main menu tap Deposits; endorse the check (sign, then write 'For deposit only at Truist' under the signature — troubleshooting FAQ also says to add the deposit date); select the account receiving the deposit; enter the check amount; when prompted take photos of the front and back (dark background, all four corners in frame); select Continue. One check per deposit; current daily/monthly limits shown on the Deposits tab.

touchpoints.screen: Main menu > Deposits > (account) > amount > front/back capture > Continue

moments.title: If offered, choose Immediate Availability and accept disclosed fee (2%…
moments.customer_action: If offered, choose Immediate Availability and accept disclosed fee (2% ≥$100 / $1 <$100; one check per transaction; ≥$5)
moments.action: If offered, choose Immediate Availability and accept disclosed fee (2% ≥$100 / $1 <$100; one check per transaction; ≥$5)
moments.frontstage: Immediate availability is offered selectively per check ('Several factors are considered ... the check itself, the issuing account, and the depositing account'); if offered the customer must accept the immediate availability service disclosure during each transaction; fee 2% (≥$100) / $1 (<$100); checks under $5 ineligible.

moments.title: Deposits by 9pm ET Mon–Fri count same banking day; standard funds next…
moments.action: Deposits by 9pm ET Mon–Fri count same banking day; standard funds next business day unless hold; deposit history (24 months)
moments.frontstage: Standard availability: images received before 9 pm ET on a banking day count as that day's deposit; 'pending deposits will appear in your account transaction activity, and your available balance will be updated once the check successfully posts' (next business day unless hold). Immediate availability: available balance updated immediately (minus fee); deposits by 11:59 pm ET included in nightly overdraft processing. Deposit history: 24 months.

fail_points.text: Community reports 10–11 day holds on large/cashier's checks

moments.title: On-screen confirmation; deposit alerts channel UNKNOWN
moments.action: On-screen confirmation; deposit alerts channel UNKNOWN
moments.frontstage: In-app confirmation that Truist received the image ('An image of an item shall be deemed received when you receive a confirmation from Truist'; receipt does not guarantee acceptance). Customizable account alerts exist ('Get customizable account alerts right to your phone') but a deposit-specific alert type is not documented.

moments.title: View deposit history (24 months); retain the paper check — FAQ: 'Secure…
moments.customer_action: View deposit history (24 months); retain the paper check — FAQ: 'Secure and properly destroy your check ten business days after your deposit is confirmed'; agreement minimum: retain at least 7 calendar days from image transmission, then destroy or mark 'VOID', and provide it to Truist on request during retention.

moments.title: Rejected image / ineligible item / hold → notification and re-deposit…
moments.customer_action: Rejected image / ineligible item / hold → notification and re-deposit or branch; hold disputes via Care Center
moments.action: Rejected image / ineligible item / hold → notification and re-deposit or branch; hold disputes via Care Center
moments.frontstage: Ineligible items (Canadian/foreign checks, US savings bonds, TTL payments, traveler's checks, money orders; third-party, altered, joint-payee mismatch, substitute, remotely created, non-USD, >6 months old, sight drafts, previously deposited) and incorrectly endorsed checks 'may not be deposited'; Truist may reject any item or charge back an ineligible item later; troubleshooting FAQ lists signal/camera/lighting fixes; errors must be reported within 30 days of the statement; more than three returned items in 90 days ends eligibility.

exceptions.customer_experience: Deposit may be refused in-app ('Checks endorsed incorrectly may not be deposited') or accepted then charged back later; customer re-endorses/re-captures or deposits at a branch/ATM.
exceptions.bank_handling: Truist 'reserve[s] the right to reject any item ... without liability' and 'to charge back to your account at any time, any item that we subsequently determine was not an eligible item'; more than three returned items in 90 days removes mobile-deposit eligibility.
exceptions.resolution: Re-deposit correctly or via branch/ATM; errors reported within 30 days of statement.

assessment: Fee-based instant availability (also at ATM) is a monetized differentiator; endorsement/limit disclosure is thin on public pages.

terms.limits: 'Deposit limits apply' (not published); SMB 'higher deposit limits'
